r-splitfngr.name: r-splitfngr
r-splitfngr.summary: Some R functions, such as optim(), require a function its gradient passed as separate arguments. When these are expensive to calculate it may be much faster to calculate the function (fn) and gradient (gr) together since they often share many calculations (chain rule). The functions provided allow this to be done with any number of functions/values, not just for functions and gradients.
